title: Allen AI Publishes Nature Paper on Byte Level LLM Adaptation
summary:
A new method from Allen AI allows existing large language models to operate over bytes without needing to be trained from scratch. The research, published in the journal Nature, introduces a process called "byteification" that serves as the technical foundation for the Bolmo model. To demonstrate the versatility of the approach, the organization released new checkpoints that apply the method to the Qwen and Llama model families, expanding beyond its initial use in the Olmo model.

The adaptation requires a short additional training run to modify the model's core. This process adds components that group bytes into variable length patches for processing and then expand outputs back to byte level representations to predict the next byte. Lead author @bminixhofer completed the majority of the development during a 3 month internship.
